title: ST-Topo GAN: A Motor EEG-to-EMG Decoding Model Matched to Wrist Movement Complexity
abstract: arXiv:2609.22128v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The wrist plays a critical role in upper-limb function by enabling precise hand positioning, force regulation, and object manipulation. Continuous brain--muscle interfaces (BMIs) offer a promising approach for motor restoration by decoding neural activity into muscle activation signals. However, existing EEG-to-EMG models have mainly been developed for tasks with relatively stable muscle synergies and may be less effective for the heterogeneous and weakly coupled neuromuscular organisation involved in wrist movements. This paper proposes ST-Topo GAN, a Spatial--Temporal Topological Generative Adversarial Network for continuous EEG-to-EMG decoding of wrist movements. The framework integrates multi-band EEG representation, sensorimotor cortical topology modelling, and conditional adversarial learning to reconstruct multi-channel iEMG activation. translated_title: ST-Topo GAN：一种与手腕运动复杂度相匹配的运动脑电到肌电解码模型
translated_abstract: 手腕通过实现精确的手部定位、力量调节和物体操作，在上肢功能中发挥着关键作用。连续脑-肌接口（BMI）通过将神经活动解码为肌肉激活信号，为运动功能恢复提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，现有的脑电到肌电（EEG-to-EMG）模型主要针对肌肉协同相对稳定的任务而开发，对于手腕运动所涉及的异质且弱耦合的神经肌肉组织可能效果欠佳。本文提出了ST-Topo GAN，一种时空拓扑生成对抗网络，用于手腕运动的连续脑电到肌电解码。该框架集成了多频段脑电表示、感觉运动皮层拓扑建模和条件对抗学习，以重建多通道肌内肌电（iEMG）激活。该模型通过跨任务比较、手腕脑电到肌内肌电解码以及消融实验进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出ST-Topo GAN，一种融合多频段脑电表示、感觉运动皮层拓扑建模与条件对抗学习的时空拓扑生成对抗网络，实现了针对手腕运动复杂神经肌肉组织的连续脑电到肌电解码。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ST-Topo GAN, a spatial-temporal topological GAN integrating multi-band EEG representation, sensorimotor cortical topology modeling, and conditional adversarial learning, enabling continuous EEG-to-EMG decoding matched to the complex neuromuscular organization of wrist movements.
